content.rendered:
Come cheer on your students and their classmates as they participate in the Fun Run and raise money for our school.  The schedule is as follows:
3rd Grade – 8:15am – 8:40am
1st Grade – 8:50am – 9:15am
2nd Grade – 9:25-9:50am
Kindergarten 10:00am-10:25am
4th Grade – 12:30pm-12:55pm
5th Grade – 1:05pm-1:30pm
